entries.title: Tamil Language
entries.content: Tamil is a classical Dravidian language with 2000+ years of recorded literature (Sangam era). Official language of Tamil Nadu & Puducherry, Sri Lanka and Singapore. Oldest living language with rich literature tradition.

entries.title: Tanglish
entries.content: Tanglish is Tamil written in Roman/English letters mixed with English words, common in everyday speech in Tamil Nadu. Example: 'Enna venum?' means 'What do you want?'. Rolex understands Tamil, English, and Tanglish.

entries.title: Rolex AI Identity
entries.content: Rolex is a personal AI assistant built in Python. Codename ROLEX, wake word 'Hey Guru'. Rolex calculates locally (math, engineering), searches a local knowledge base, and uses external AI providers (OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama) only as intelligence sources - the final answer is always composed and owned by Rolex itself.

entries.title: Rolex Architecture
entries.content: Flow: USER -> ROLEX CORE -> INTENT ROUTER -> (LOCAL BRAIN / TOOLS & ACTIONS / KNOWLEDGE) -> INTELLIGENCE HUB (parallel: OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama) -> VALIDATOR -> ROLEX FINAL ANSWER -> MEMORY & LEARNING -> USER. Math questions never go to AI: User -> Math Detector -> ROLEX LOCAL CALCULATOR -> Validate -> Exact Answer.

entries.title: Indian Rupee & Units
entries.content: Indian currency is the Rupee (INR, symbol Rs or ₹). Indian numbering: 1 lakh = 100,000; 1 crore = 10,000,000. Electricity in Tamil Nadu is commonly billed per unit (1 kWh); domestic rate around ₹8 per unit.

entries.title: Indian Standard Time
entries.content: Indian Standard Time (IST) is UTC+5:30. India has no daylight saving time. IST is used across the entire country.

entries.title: Metric Prefixes
entries.content: SI prefixes: kilo (k) = 10^3, mega (M) = 10^6, giga (G) = 10^9, tera (T) = 10^12, milli (m) = 10^-3, micro (µ) = 10^-6, nano (n) = 10^-9, pico (p) = 10^-12. 1 kVA = 1000 VA, 1 mA = 0.001 A.

entries.title: Solar System Planets
entries.content: The Solar System has 8 planets orbiting the Sun. Order from the Sun: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune. Inner planets (Mercury-Mars) are rocky; outer planets (Jupiter-Neptune) are gas/ice giants. Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet in 2006.

entries.title: Effective Study Techniques
entries.content: Effective study techniques: spaced repetition (revisit material at increasing intervals), active recall (test yourself instead of re-reading), the Feynman technique (explain the concept simply as if teaching), and Pomodoro (25 minutes focused work + 5 minute break). Sleep consolidates memory - 7-8 hours before exams beats all-night cramming.
